events.verdict: Johnson (SAS) makes clean contact with the ball that deflects Clarkson's (UTA) pass attempt, prior to any incidental arm contact occurring.
Castle (SAS) reaches around Filipowski's (UTA) body and marginal brush contact occurs to his arm during the drive.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Filipowski (UTA) touches the ball last before going out of bounds.
Castle (SAS) immediately slides his arm off of Clarkson's (UTA) front and marginal contact occurs as the screen is set.

Wembanyama (SAS) makes clean contact with the ball that dislodges it during Filipowski's (UTA) driving shot attempt. Following the contact with the ball, Wembanyama's arm follows through and makes incidental contact with Filipowski's face and arm.
After jumping vertically and absorbing the marginal body contact, Wembanyama (SAS) lowers his arm and makes clean contact with the ball during Collins' (UTA) play at the basket.
Johnson (SAS) is not in full control of the ball as he returns to the floor, he then gathers it on his right foot and releases the ball to pass.
Sexton (UTA) does not overtly extend his arm through Paul's (SAS) space and marginal contact occurs as Sexton releases away, prior to stepping back.
Castle (SAS) brings his arms forward without extending into Clarkson (UTA) and marginal contact occurs as Castle releases his screening position.
Filipowski (UTA) is moving alongside Paul's (SAS) path and marginal lower body contact occurs as they come together during the drive.
Markkanen (UTA) and Vassell (SAS) mutually engage and disengage as the pick is set and the contact is marginal.
Castle (SAS) makes contact with Clarkson's (UTA) arm, which affects his jump shot attempt.

Replay review of the foul called on Wembanyama (SAS) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Wembanyama (SAS) does not establish screening position in Clarkson's (UTA) path and delivers more than marginal contact during the pick.
Champagnie (SAS) commits a take foul in Clarkson (UTA).
Champagnie (SAS) and Collins (UTA) engage and disengage with one another and marginal contact occurs off-ball.
Vassell (SAS) commits a take foul on Sexton (UTA).
